qa.question: How do I process a customer refund?
fails: answer has none of ['check stock', 'Check stock']
qa.text: Open Orders, find the order, only refund Delivered orders with the item back in stock, choose a reason, click Issue refund, retype the order number and click Confirm refund [S1]. The Customer refund process (simulated back office) says refunds above $200 need a supervisor code [S1]. The How to process a customer refund (screen recording, simulated back office) says refunds above $500 need a supervisor code [S4].

qa.question: Why do we check stock before paying a refund?
qa.text: We check stock because the returned item must be back in stock before any refund is paid [S1]. The guide explains this as the item has to be back on the shelf before we pay anything out [S2].

qa.question: Above what amount does a refund need a supervisor code?
